name: Banc of California, Inc.
reason: Transformational 2023 PacWest merger produced a -$22.71 EPS loss, shares up 15.7%/yr and 10y avg ROE -3.2% - no record of disciplined, forecastable banking.

name: First Financial Bancorp.
reason: Ordinary acquisitive Midwest bank: ROE averages 9.9%, shares up 4.5%/yr from M&A and EPS already 0.99x its 10y peak - cheap but not special.

name: Choice Hotels International, Inc.
reason: Asset-light franchisor with 24% avg ROIC and 12% EPS CAGR, but net debt/EBITDA 3.5x, EPS at 10y high with consensus LTG only 3.4% and soft US economy-hotel RevPAR make the 7%+ path uncertain.

name: DXC Technology Co.
reason: Shrinking legacy IT outsourcer exposed to AI/cloud disintermediation: EBIT margin 2.0%, EPS 0.39x 10y peak and adjusted EPS far above GAAP.

name: Conagra Brands, Inc.
reason: Packaged food in volume decline (GLP-1 and private-label pressure): 5y EPS CAGR -8.2%, margin at 18th pctile and net debt/EBITDA 4.4x after Pinnacle acquisition.

name: Hope Bancorp, Inc.
reason: Korean-American CRE-heavy bank with 10y EPS CAGR -8.3%, EPS 0.27x its 10y peak and ROE averaging 7.4% - no specialness.

name: Globe Life Inc.
reason: Simple, persistent life/supplemental-health underwriter with 13.2% 10y EPS CAGR, share count down 4.2%/yr, no acquisitions and ~15% ROE; agency-practice probes are a monitorable rather than existential risk.

name: Assurant, Inc.
reason: EPS CAGR 11.6% but mobile protection depends on a few large carrier clients, housing is cat-exposed lender-placed insurance and adjusted EPS runs 41% above GAAP.

name: Horace Mann Educators Corporation
reason: Niche educator insurer with volatile personal-lines P&C results (EPS -69.6% in 2022) and 10y avg ROE 7.3% - ordinary returns, EPS now at 10y high.

name: Southwest Airlines Co.
reason: Airline earnings driven by fuel, capacity and labour: EPS 0.22x its 2019 level with EBIT margin collapsing from 23% to 2.9%; business model in transition.

name: The Andersons, Inc.
reason: Grain merchandising and ethanol with ~1% EBIT margins set by commodity spreads; acq/FCF 2.55x and net debt/EBITDA 3.6x.

name: AutoNation Incorporated
reason: Cyclical auto dealer whose EPS 2021-23 spike came from vehicle shortages (EPS now 0.82x peak); growth largely from buybacks (1.52x FCF) with net debt/EBITDA 6.4x incl. floorplan.

name: Banner Corporation
reason: Sound but ordinary Pacific NW community bank: ROE averages 9.4%, EPS 0.98x 10y peak and shares up 3.8%/yr - no evident specialness.

name: Stock Yards Bancorp, Inc.
reason: Conservatively run Louisville bank with wealth/trust franchise: 11.1% 10y EPS CAGR, 7/10 years of 7%+ growth, only -10% EPS in 2020 and ~14% ROE with minimal acquisition spend.

name: Constellation Brands, Inc.
reason: Mexican beer franchise faces credible threats (US Hispanic consumer weakness, import tariffs, falling alcohol consumption): EPS -14% in 2025 and consensus LTG -0.5%.

name: Flowers Foods, Inc.
reason: Packaged bread in secular volume decline with 10y EPS CAGR 1.7%, net debt/EBITDA 3.9x after Simple Mills deal and consensus FY1 EPS -28%.

name: Advance Auto Parts, Inc.
reason: Turnaround laggard in auto parts: EPS collapsed from 13.04 to 2.26, EBIT margin 2.0% vs 9% peak and net debt/EBITDA 5.7x.

name: Alaska Air Group, Inc.
reason: Airline with fuel/cycle-driven earnings plus Hawaiian integration: EPS 0.33x 10y peak, acq/FCF 1.32x and adjusted EPS far above GAAP.

name: Old Republic International Corporation
reason: Disciplined specialty commercial P&C underwriter with a century-long record, 9.4% 10y EPS CAGR, ~13% ROE and no acquisitions; title segment adds housing cyclicality to watch.

name: Global Payments Inc.
reason: Mid-transformation (Worldpay swap for Issuer Solutions) with acq/FCF 0.67x, GAAP ROIC 3.6% vs adjusted EPS far above GAAP and fintech share-loss risk in SMB merchant acquiring.
